Name: Biological Structure
Description: Phase: Any Phase Type: Passive This Unit cannot gain the BURROWED Status, cannot be returned to Reserves, and is immune to the IMPACT keyword.

Name: Source Of Creep (Bile Launcher)
Description: Phase: Any Phase Type: Passive A Friendly or Enemy Ground Zerg Unit Within 6" of this Unit counts as being ON CREEP.

Name: Bombard
Description: Phase: Movement Phase Type: Active Cost: 1 BM Set a Bile Bomb token on the battlefield Within 24" of this Unit. When this Unit resolves a Ranged Attack using the Bile Bomb weapon profile this Round, it may choose to ignore the weapon's standard Range characteristic. If it does, it may target an Enemy Unit that is Within 3" of that token (Line of Sight is not required), ignoring the HIDDEN Status. After the attack is fully resolved, remove the Bile Bomb token from the battlefield. When the Bile Bomb token is about to be removed, set a Creep Tumor token in base-to-base contact with it. The Bile Bomb token has DISPLACEMENT.

Name: Burrow Ambush (Bile Launcher, Vileling (Zergling))
Description: Phase: Movement Phase Type: Passive When this Unit is nominated to deploy from the Reserves, it may resolve the PLACE (18) effect from the controlling player's Entry Edge. No model may be set Within 10" of any Enemy model. This Unit's Activation ends.

Name: Burrow (Corpsers (Roach), Roaches)
Description: Phase: Any Phase Type: Active Cost: 2 BM If this Unit is Unengaged, it gains or loses the Burrowed Status.

Name: Regeneration
Description: Phase: Assault Phase Type: Passive When this Unit becomes Activated, if it has the Burrowed Status, resolve the HEAL (2) effect.

Name: Roachling Infestation
Description: Phase: Movement Phase Type: Active Cost: 2 BM Once Per Game. Resolve the SUMMON (Roachling) effect.

Name: <color=#2596be>Tunneling Claws (Corpsers (Roach), Roaches)</color>
Description: Phase: Any Phase Type: Passive Upgrade ability While this Unit has the Burrowed Status, it may perform the Move and Run actions without losing that Status. It may also move through other Units' bases.

Name: <color=#2596be>Hydriodic Bile</color>
Description: Phase: Assault Phase Type: Passive Upgrade ability This Unit's Acid Saliva weapon gains Surge Type: Light, and S Dice: D3+1.

Name: <color=#2596be>Burrow Ambush (Corpsers (Roach), Hydralisks, Raptors (Zergling), Ravagers, Roaches, Swarmlings, Viles (Roach), Zerglings)</color>
Description: Phase: Movement Phase Type: Passive Upgrade ability When this Unit is nominated to deploy from the Reserves, it may resolve the PLACE (18) effect from the controlling player's Entry Edge. No model may be set Within 10" of any Enemy model. This Unit's Activation ends.

Name: <color=#2596be>Glial Reconstitution (Corpsers (Roach), Roaches)</color>
Description: Phase: Movement Phase Type: Active Cost: 1 CP Upgrade ability This Unit gains BUFF SPEED (1), or BUFF SPEED (2) if the Unit is ON CREEP.

Name: Consume
Description: Phase: Any Phase Type: Passive When this Unit resolves a Special Ability that costs BM, it can remove one model from a Friendly Unit Within 4" to generate 1 BM to spend towards that ability's cost.

Name: Dark Swarm
Description: Phase: Assault Phase Type: Reaction Cost: 1 BM REPEATABLE. Use when a Friendly Unit Within 4" of a Friendly Dark Swarm token is selected as the target of an attack. If this Unit is Within 4'' of the same token, the Targeted Friendly Unit is eligible to make an Evade Roll against that attack. If the targeted Unit is a Size 1, it gains a +1 Modifier to this Evade Roll.

Name: Gestate Dark Swarm
Description: Phase: Movement Phase Type: Active Cost: 0 BM Set a Dark Swarm token in an unoccupied space Within 4" and Line of Sight of this Unit. The Dark Swarm token has DISPLACEMENT.

Name: <color=#2596be>Plague</color>
Description: Phase: Assault Phase Type: Active Cost: X BM Upgrade ability You may spend 1 to 3 BM to activate this ability. Set a Plague Blast Template Wholly Within 10" and Line of Sight of this Unit. For each Unit that has at least one model whose base is partially covered by the template, roll 2 dice, plus 1 additional die for each model in that Unit whose base is partially covered. That Unit loses its HIDDEN Status, and, depending on the BM spent, it suffers NON-LETHAL DAMAGE (1) for: 1 BM: each result of 5+. 2 BM: each result of 4+. 3 BM: each result of 3+.

Name: <color=#2596be>Burrow Ambush (Defiler)</color>
Description: Phase: Movement Phase Type: Passive Upgrade ability When this Unit is nominated to deploy from Reserves, it may resolve the PLACE (18) effect from the controlling player's Entry Edge. No model may be placed Within 10" of any Enemy model. This Unit's Activation ends.

Name: Lunge
Description: Phase: Assault Phase Type: Reaction Cost: 1 BM When another Friendly Unit Within 10" is the target of a Ranged Attack, after the attack is fully resolved, this Unit, if Unengaged, may perform a Move action Directly Towards the attacking Unit.

Name: <color=#2596be>Ancillary Carapace</color>
Description: Phase: Any Phase Type: Passive Upgrade ability This Unit gains TOUGH (1) on the first Armour Roll of each Activation.
<u><link="pdf_Zerg_rule_hydralisks_upgrade_any_phase_ancillary_carapace"><color=#65c879>(TOUGH (1) — first Armour Roll of each activation)</color></link></u>

Name: <color=#2596be>Lurking</color>
Description: Phase: Any Phase Type: Passive Upgrade ability If this Unit has Stationary Status, it is eligible to make an Evade Roll against the first Ranged Attack targeting it this Round. If this Unit is ON CREEP, it gains +1 Modifier to this Evade Roll.
<u><link="pdf_Zerg_rule_hydralisks_upgrade_any_phase_lurking"><color=#65c879>(Evade eligible — stationary, first ranged attack; +1 on creep)</color></link></u>

Name: <color=#2596be>Grooved Spines</color>
Description: Phase: Assault Phase Type: Passive Upgrade ability This Unit's Needle Spines ranged weapon gains LONG RANGE (16").

Name: Leaping Strike
Description: Phase: Assault Phase Type: Active Cost: 1 BM If Unengaged, resolve the PLACE (6) effect.

Name: Crushing Grip
Description: Phase: Movement Phase Type: Active Cost: 1 BM Select one Enemy Unit Within 12". That Unit counts as Activated in this Phase (set an Activation Marker next to it).

Name: Mutating Carapace
Description: Phase: Movement Phase Type: Active Cost: 1 BM Select one Enemy Unit Within 18". This Unit is eligible to make an Evade Roll against all attacks made by the selected Enemy Unit, with a +2 Modifier applied to those Evade Rolls.

Name: Raptor Strain
Description: Phase: Any Phase Type: Passive This Unit can move through IMPASSABLE TERRAIN of Size 4 or less and change elevation without using ACCESS POINTS.

Name: Adrenal Overload
Description: Phase: Assault Phase Type: Active Cost: 1 BM This Unit gains a +1 Modifier to all IMPACT Hit Rolls.

Name: Devastating Charge IMPACT (2) 5+
Description: Phase: Assault Phase Type: Passive Immediately after this Unit completes a successful Charge, resolve the IMPACT (2) 5+ effect.

Name: Leap
Description: Phase: Assault Phase Type: Active Cost: 1 BM When determining Charge Distance for this Unit, add 2 to the Charge Distance.

Name: Detection (Omega Worm)
Description: Phase: Any Phase Type: Passive While Enemy Units are Within 6" of this Unit, they lose HIDDEN Status.

Name: Omega Network
Description: Phase: Any Phase Type: Passive The base of the Omega Worm counts as an Entry Edge. Each Round, Friendly Units with a combined Supply cost of 2 or less may be Deployed via this Entry Edge. If a Friendly Leading model finishes a Move, Disengage, or Run action in base-to-base contact with the Omega Worm, the controlling player may remove that Unit from the battlefield and return it to Reserves.

Name: Source Of Creep (Omega Worm)
Description: Phase: Any Phase Type: Passive A Friendly or Enemy Ground Zerg Unit Within 6" of this Unit, counts as being ON CREEP.

Name: Psionic Link
Description: Phase: Any Phase Type: Passive Once per Round, if there are at least 7 Friendly models Within 6" of this Unit, it may resolve its Special Ability with the BM cost reduced by 1.

Name: Restoration (Queen)
Description: Phase: Any Phase Type: Reaction Cost: 1 BM Use when a Friendly Unit Within 4" receives a DEBUFF. Remove all DEBUFFS from it.

Name: Spawn Creep Tumor
Description: Phase: Any Phase Type: Active Cost: 1 BM Set a Creep Tumor token in base-to-base contact with this Unit.

Name: Transfusion
Description: Phase: Any Phase Type: Reaction Cost: 1 BM Use when another Friendly Biological Unit (including a Structure) suffers Damage Within 4". Reduce the Total Damage before allocation by 2.

Name: <color=#2596be>Creep Speed</color>
Description: Phase: Any Phase Type: Passive Upgrade ability While this Unit is ON CREEP, increase this Unit's Speed characteristic by 2.

Name: <color=#2596be>Domineering Presence</color>
Description: Phase: Movement Phase Type: Active Cost: 1 BM Upgrade ability Select another Friendly Unit Within 6" (Line of Sight is not required). That Unit's Supply characteristic is increased by 1 for Controlling and Contesting Mission Markers and completing objectives.

Name: Devastating Charge IMPACT (1) 5+
Description: Phase: Assault Phase Type: Passive Immediately after this Unit completes a successful Charge, resolve the IMPACT (1) 5+ effect.

Name: Metabolic Boost
Description: Phase: Assault Phase Type: Active Cost: 1 BM When determining Charge Distance for this Unit, roll 2D6 instead of D6 and use the higher result to add to the Unit's Speed characteristic.

Name: <color=#2596be>Adrenal Glands</color>
Description: Phase: Melee Phase Type: Passive Upgrade ability This Unit's Claws and Shredding Claws weapons gain PRECISION (2).

Name: <color=#2596be><color=#2596be>PRECISION (2)</color></color>
Description: Phase: Melee Phase Type: Passive Upgrade ability This Unit's Claws and Shredding Claws weapons gain PRECISION (2).

Name: Devastating Charge IMPACT (2) 4+
Description: Phase: Assault Phase Type: Passive Immediately after this Unit completes a successful Charge, resolve the IMPACT (2) 4+ effect.

Name: Corrosive Bile
Description: Phase: Movement Phase Type: Active Cost: 1 BM For each model in this Unit, set one Corrosive Bile token on the battlefield Within 14" of that model. These tokens are not removed if this Unit is Destroyed. At the End of the Assault Phase, each Unit suffers HITS 5 (1) effect for each of this Unit's Corrosive Bile tokens it is Within 1" of. Then, remove all of this Unit's Corrosive Bile tokens from the battlefield. If multiple effects trigger at the End of the Assault Phase, resolve them in the order specified in Part 8.9.4.

Name: Deep Tunnel
Description: Phase: Movement Phase Type: Active Cost: 1 BM Set a Ravager Burrow token Wholly Within 12" of any model in this Unit. At the End of the Round, the controlling player may set all models of this Unit in Coherency, treating the Ravager Burrow token as the Leading Model. The Ravager Burrow token has DISPLACEMENT.

Name: <color=#2596be>Bloated Bile Ducts</color>
Description: Phase: Any Phase Type: Passive Upgrade ability Increase the area of effect of this Unit's Corrosive Bile ability to 2".

Name: <color=#2596be>Corrosive Bile (Area 2")</color>
Description: Upgrade ability Phase: Movement Phase Type: Active Cost: 1 BM For each model in this Unit, set one Corrosive Bile token on the battlefield Within 14" of that model. These tokens are not removed if this Unit is Destroyed. At the End of the Assault Phase, each Unit suffers HITS 5 (1) effect for each of this Unit's Corrosive Bile tokens it is Within 2" of. Then, remove all of this Unit's Corrosive Bile tokens from the battlefield. If multiple effects trigger at the End of the Assault Phase, resolve them in the order specified in Part 8.9.4.

Name: <color=#2596be>Potent Bile</color>
Description: Phase: Assault Phase Type: Passive Upgrade ability Before an Enemy Unit resolves an Armour Roll against the HITS effect generated by this Unit's Corrosive Bile ability, that Unit suffers DEBUFF Armour (1).

Description: Phase: Melee Phase Type: Passive After an Enemy Unit suffers Damage from this Unit, apply DEBUFF Hit (1) to each of that Unit's Weapons.

Description: Phase: Any Phase Type: Active Cost: 2 BM If this Unit is not Engaged, it gains or loses the Burrowed Status.

Description: Phase: Any Phase Type: Reaction Cost: 1 BM Use when an Enemy Unit Within 8" of this Unit declares a Ranged Attack. Apply DEBUFF Hit (1) to each of that Unit's Ranged Weapons.

Description: Phase: Assault Phase Type: Passive Immediately after this Unit completes a successful Charge, resolve the IMPACT (6) 3+ effect.

Name: Infested Drop
Description: Phase: Movement Phase Type: Passive The base of the Zagara counts as an Entry Edge. Each Round, Friendly Units with a combined Supply cost of 1 may be Deployed via this Entry Edge.

Name: <color=#2596be>Broodmother</color>
Description: Phase: Movement Phase Type: Active Cost: 1 BM Upgrade ability Apply one of the following effects to all Friendly units (Line of Sight is not required). You cannot apply the effect chosen in the previous Game Round: • Units of Size 1 gain a +1 Modifier to all IMPACT Rolls. • All weapons of Size 2 Units gain CRITICAL HIT (1). • Units of Size 3 or more gain TOUGH (1).
